project_code.label: Project code
project_code.help: Uppercase project identity constrained to letters, digits, and hyphens.

company.label: Company
company.help: Operator-facing identity only; Issue Chaser runtime behavior does not read it.

safety_sheet_id.label: Safety workbook
safety_sheet_id.help: Google workbook containing Safety history and the optional Novade Name List.

lambda_url.label: Send-message URL
lambda_url.help: HTTPS listener URL ending in /send-message; document and mention endpoints are derived from it.

instance_name.label: WhatsApp instance
instance_name.help: Required and non-blank before the project can be enabled.

client_id.label: Client ID
client_id.help: Required and non-blank before the project can be enabled.

whatsapp_group_ids.label: Fallback groups
whatsapp_group_ids.help: Fixed destinations when origin routing is disabled, or the sole safe fallback when origin recovery fails (INV-ICH-08).

safety_summary_whatsapp_group_ids.label: Safety summary groups
safety_summary_whatsapp_group_ids.help: Legacy shared destination for all three past-days summary styles, used only while every style-specific destination is blank; then whatsapp_group_ids is the final fallback (INV-ICH-12).

daily_safety_summary_whatsapp_group_ids.label: Plain summary groups
daily_safety_summary_whatsapp_group_ids.help: Fixed destinations for the plain past-days summary. When any style-specific destination exists, this route uses only this field (INV-ICH-12).

daily_safety_company_summary_whatsapp_gr.label: Company summary groups
daily_safety_company_summary_whatsapp_gr.help: Fixed destinations for the company past-days summary. When any style-specific destination exists, this route uses only this field (INV-ICH-12).

daily_safety_chatgroup_summary_whatsapp_.label: ChatGroup summary groups
daily_safety_chatgroup_summary_whatsapp_.help: Fixed destinations for the ChatGroup past-days summary. When any style-specific destination exists, this route uses only this field (INV-ICH-12).

novade_name_list_check_whatsapp_group_id.label: Name-list audit groups
novade_name_list_check_whatsapp_group_id.help: Fixed destinations for the weekly Name List audit; blank falls back to whatsapp_group_ids (INV-ICH-15).

exclude_whatsapp_group_ids.label: Snapshot exclusions
exclude_whatsapp_group_ids.help: Groups excluded only from live same-day snapshot delivery, after final routing (INV-ICH-14).

enabled.label: Project enabled
enabled.help: Final project gate; a feature style must also be enabled before anything runs (INV-ICH-01).

severity_cadence_chaser_enabled.label: Severity cadence
severity_cadence_chaser_enabled.help: Enables persistent P1/P2/P3 reminders with successful-delivery cursors.

same_day_open_snapshot_enabled.label: Same-day snapshot
same_day_open_snapshot_enabled.help: Enables project-local same-day open snapshots using the configured lookback and schedule.

daily_safety_summary_enabled.label: Daily safety summary
daily_safety_summary_enabled.help: Enables the read-only past-days safety summary to fixed project destinations (INV-ICH-12).

daily_safety_company_summary_enabled.label: Company safety summary
daily_safety_company_summary_enabled.help: Enables the read-only past-days company breakdown to fixed project destinations (INV-ICH-12).

daily_safety_chatgroup_summary_enabled.label: ChatGroup safety summary
daily_safety_chatgroup_summary_enabled.help: Enables the read-only past-days ChatGroup breakdown to fixed project destinations (INV-ICH-12).

novade_name_list_check_enabled.label: Name-list audit
novade_name_list_check_enabled.help: Enables the weekly read-only Name List completeness check; a clean result sends nothing (INV-ICH-15).

novade_name_sync_enabled.label: Novade name sync
novade_name_sync_enabled.help: Enables the narrow on-demand PIC-cell write route; it sends no WhatsApp and dryRun true previews only (INV-ICH-16).

summary_days.label: Summary days
summary_days.help: Positive count of consecutive Singapore dates included by both past-days summaries.

include_days_before_snapshot.label: Snapshot lookback
include_days_before_snapshot.help: Non-negative number of preceding dates included when the request does not override it (INV-ICH-09).

severity_only_last_x_days.label: Severity reminder lookback
severity_only_last_x_days.help: Optional non-negative number of preceding Singapore dates eligible for severity cadence; null leaves it unlimited (INV-ICH-18).

same_day_open_snapshot_schedule.label: Snapshot schedule
same_day_open_snapshot_schedule.help: Semicolon-separated HH00,lookback entries consulted only for scheduled invocations.

daily_safety_summary_schedule.label: Safety summary schedule
daily_safety_summary_schedule.help: Semicolon-separated HH00,lookback entries for scheduled plain summaries.

daily_safety_company_summary_schedule.label: Company summary schedule
daily_safety_company_summary_schedule.help: Semicolon-separated HH00,lookback entries for scheduled company summaries.

daily_safety_chatgroup_summary_schedule.label: ChatGroup summary schedule
daily_safety_chatgroup_summary_schedule.help: Semicolon-separated HH00,lookback entries for scheduled ChatGroup summaries.

severity_p1_window_start.label: P1 window start
severity_p1_window_start.help: Optional inclusive Singapore-time start; both P1 ends must be null for 24-hour eligibility.

severity_p1_window_end.label: P1 window end
severity_p1_window_end.help: Optional exclusive Singapore-time end; overnight windows are supported.

severity_p2_p3_window_start.label: P2/P3 window start
severity_p2_p3_window_start.help: Optional inclusive Singapore-time start shared by P2 and P3.

severity_p2_p3_window_end.label: P2/P3 window end
severity_p2_p3_window_end.help: Optional exclusive Singapore-time end shared by P2 and P3; overnight windows are supported.

send_to_originating_groups.label: Send to originating groups
send_to_originating_groups.help: Default safety boundary: route to serialized origin and use a configured fallback only when exactly one exists (INV-ICH-08).

remove_sunday_notifications.label: Mute Sundays
remove_sunday_notifications.help: Suppresses live delivery only; workbook reads, previews, and cadence calculations continue (INV-ICH-13).

remove_ph_notifications.label: Mute public holidays
remove_ph_notifications.help: Suppresses live delivery only using the code-maintained Singapore holiday list (INV-ICH-13).

constraints.name: issue_chaser_enabled_delivery_check
constraints.help: An enabled row requires a workbook and complete listener delivery configuration.

constraints.name: issue_chaser_summary_days_check
constraints.help: Summary days must be at least one.

constraints.name: issue_chaser_severity_only_last_x_days_check
constraints.help: Severity reminder lookback must be null or non-negative.

constraints.name: issue_chaser_p1_window_check
constraints.help: The P1 time window must be a complete, unequal pair or entirely null.

constraints.name: issue_chaser_p2_p3_window_check
constraints.help: The P2/P3 time window must be a complete, unequal pair or entirely null.

constraints.name: issue_chaser_summary_destination_check
constraints.help: Enabled fixed-destination reports require their dedicated group list or the legacy fallback.
